# ASU MSE Thesis Chapter Architecture — Scientific and Institutional Separation V1

**Date:** 2026-10-09
**Status:** Skill guidance / preferred document organization; **NOT an ASU-prescribed seven-chapter requirement**.
**Scientific authority:** current `project/CURRENT_THESIS_AUTHORITY_INDEX_V1.md` and current frozen thermal-only SO1–SO3; do not restore obsolete broad H1–H5 chapters or generic seven-stage science.
**Official institutional source (verified October 9, 2026):** ASU Graduate College Format Manual, https://graduate.asu.edu/current-students/completing-your-degree/formatting-your-thesis-or-dissertation/asu-graduate-college.

## Institutional truth
ASU Graduate College specifies document order, approved formatting, main text, citations, and submission procedures. The official manual does not impose a fixed universal six- or seven-chapter count. The thesis chair/supervisory committee approves the final scientific organization, subject to program rules. Distinguish recommended chapter design from university policy and other authoritative rules.
Manual §Contents and order: title page; copyright if used; abstract; optional dedication/acknowledgments; table of contents; lists of tables/figures when present; additional lists/preface if used; main text; endnotes if used; references; appendices; optional biographical sketch.
Important verified specifics: left and right 1.25-inch margins; top/bottom 1 inch; approved consistent font/size (e.g. Times New Roman 12 pt); double spacing except allowed categories; abstract <=350 words, no first-person plurals; Roman preliminary pages starting at abstract i; Arabic main text/back matter starting 1; heading formatting follows style-guide rules subject to manual. Verify live manual before release, use official ASU Format Wizard where required, and refer to chair/program for final approval.

## Preferred seven-chapter plan (NOT mandatory)
1. **Introduction** — engineering reality, literature-grounded problem, candidate evidence-bounded gap, exact frozen GO/SO1–SO3, working RQs, scope and relevance.
2. **Literature Review and Theoretical Foundations** — strongest closest prior art, full-text equations, physics, evidence/validation limits, precise novelty ceiling and conditional gap decision.
3. **System Architecture and Mathematical Framework** — complete P/T_e boundaries, four-element component analysis, mechanism/causality, thermal/energy states, source-admitted governing laws, units, assumptions, constraints, and service definitions.
4. **Research Methodology** — data provenance, case feasibility, parameter estimation, numerical implementation/verification, matched experiments, prespecified criteria, independence, validation and VVUQ.
5. **Results** — actual logged, verified/validated or clearly bounded outputs with uncertainty; never fill from mock/synthetic illustrations without accurate qualification.
6. **Discussion** — interpretation of actual findings, prior-art comparison, competing explanations, resilience through service and only bounded supported sustainability, limitations and transferability.
7. **Conclusions and Recommendations** — real answers to approved RQs/SO1–SO3, contribution vs prior art, scope of claims, limitations and future work.
Then References and Appendices according to ASU document order.

## Why this is useful
Separate **what the mathematical and physical system IS** (Ch. 3) from **how it was researched, implemented, compared and validated** (Ch. 4). Avoid repeating equations without purpose. Chapter 5 is evidence, Chapter 6 interpretation, Chapter 7 conclusions. A six-chapter alternative is permissible subject to chair approval; do not demand seven chapters.

## Hard qualification rule
A complete-looking seven-chapter document is neither defense-ready nor compliant without authentic results, correct citations, model/source qualification, committee review and ASU procedural requirements. Start with source-qualified research, not another mock. Use Version B for scientific reasoning and Version A for qualification and traceability as analytical preferences, not university mandates.

## Output rules for Dossiya Research Expert
On any "chapter count", thesis structure, writing or ASU submission request:
1. State accurately that no universal ASU chapter number is prescribed by the manual.
2. Recommend this seven-chapter organization as one option, conditional on chair approval.
3. Label official formatting / institutional requirements separately from the science-specific research plan.
4. Preserve full P and T_e scope, thermal under extreme heat, state-time focus, and exact frozen objectives.
5. Keep proposed, implemented, verified, validated and committee-approved statuses separate.
6. Provide adjacent APA-style source citations for external claims; cite the official Graduate College URL for its actual rules. Do not treat the manual as defining the scientific gap or methodology.
